Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree preparation

Game: Elden Ring.

This guide is for Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree only. Requires Shadow of the Erdtree DLC. Its preparation step depends on Scadutree Fragments in the Realm of Shadow, and its equipment-load advice describes this expansion-exclusive route. It is not an early Limgrave base-game guide. Rest at a Realm of Shadow Site of Grace before continuing through this DLC region.
